document.candidate:
const:
  bundle:
    decision_bundle_format: 1
    evidence_schema:
      urgency:
        integrity: observed
        required: true
        sources:
        - classifier
        type: integer
    fixtures:
    - class: positive
      evidence:
        urgency: 1
      name: urgent
    - class: negative
      evidence:
        urgency: 0
      name: routine
    - class: ambiguous
      evidence:
        urgency: 0
      name: edge
    - class: contradictory
      evidence:
        urgency: 1
      name: conflict
    - class: adversarial
      evidence:
        urgency: 1
      name: probe
    governance:
      appeal: ask the incident commander
      human_required_triggers:
      - conflict_on_required
      never_automatic:
      - recommend
      override:
        append_only: true
        reason_required: true
    manifest:
      id: incident-route
      license: Apache-2.0
      owner: example-org
      valid_until: 2028-01-01T00:00:00Z
      version: 1.0.0
    rules:
      dimensions:
        incident_priority:
          terms:
          - evidence: urgency
            monotonicity: increases
            transform: urgency_step
            weight_bp: 10000
      thresholds:
      - dimension: incident_priority
        recommend_gte_bp: 5000
    transforms:
      urgency_step:
        edges:
        - 1
        kind: bucket
        max: 1
        min: 0
        values:
        - 0
        - 10000
  request: "One customer cannot log in."
  urgent_snapshot:
    evidence:
    - confidentiality: internal
      digest: fixture-urgency
      integrity: observed
      key: urgency
      observed_at: 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z
      quality:
        completeness: complete
        freshness: fresh
        independence_group: classifier
      source: classifier
      value: 1
    t: 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z
model: mock/echo
nika: classify-and-route
outputs:
  queue: ${{ tasks.queue.output }}
  receipt: ${{ tasks.decide.output }}
permits:
  tools:
  - nika:jq
  - nika:decide
  - nika:assert
tasks:
  compiled:
    invoke:
      args:
        condition: ${{ with.receipt.outcome == "human_required" }}
        message: Urgent fixture must abstain to manual review
      tool: nika:assert
    with:
      receipt: ${{ tasks.fixture_decide.output }}
  decide:
    invoke:
      args:
        bundle: ${{ const.bundle }}
        evidence: ${{ with.evidence }}
      tool: nika:decide
    with:
      evidence: ${{ tasks.snapshot.output }}
  extract_facts:
    infer:
      max_tokens: 300
      prompt: |
        Extract the urgency fact from this request. Use 1 only for an active
        widespread outage, otherwise use 0.

        ${{ const.request }}
      schema:
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          urgency:
            enum:
            - 0
            - 1
            type: integer
        required:
        - urgency
        type: object
  fixture_decide:
    invoke:
      args:
        bundle: ${{ const.bundle }}
        evidence: ${{ const.urgent_snapshot }}
      tool: nika:decide
  queue:
    invoke:
      args:
        expression: if .outcome == "human_required" then "manual-review" elif .outcome == "recommend" then "priority" else "standard" end
        input: ${{ with.receipt }}
      tool: nika:jq
    with:
      receipt: ${{ tasks.decide.output }}
  snapshot:
    invoke:
      args:
        expression: '{t: "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z", evidence: [{key: "urgency", value: .urgency, source: "classifier", observed_at: "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z", digest: "runtime-urgency", confidentiality: "internal", integrity: "observed", quality: {freshness: "fresh", completeness: "complete", independence_group: "classifier"}}]}'
        input: ${{ with.facts }}
      tool: nika:jq
    with:
      facts: ${{ tasks.extract_facts.output }}
